principles: Every material metric must be reproducible from time-stamped evidence records.
Unverified extraction must remain review-required and cannot contribute to production aggregates.
A source URL and collection run must be traceable from every graph claim and aggregate snapshot.
Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence; zeroes are recorded only when a source explicitly reports zero.

CollectionRun.description: One deterministic collection execution and its Tavily request/usage metadata.

SearchCriterion.description: A named, editable Tavily search criterion.

Evidence.description: Canonical Tavily result with source URL, title, content hash, relevance, publication date, and raw reference.

Claim.description: A normalized, evidence-linked assertion with confidence, review status, extraction method, and observed time.

InvestorFirm.description: VC firm, fund, angel syndicate, or strategic investor.

Partner.description: Named investor partner with a firm-qualified identifier.

FundingRound.description: Company financing round including amount, stage, date, valuation, and roles.

Theme.description: Economic layer such as Build, Run, Trust, Distribute, Monetize, or Apply.

Market.description: Specific market/subcategory measured by the engine.

Technology.description: Technical building block used by companies.

Capability.description: Functional capability enabled by a technology.

PainPoint.description: Shared operational bottleneck with an identifiable budget surface.

Solution.description: A solution approach for a pain point.

Vendor.description: Company or project providing a solution.

Project.description: Public repository, product launch, or builder project.

Builder.description: Opt-in founder, public project owner, or aggregated builder entity.

Buyer.description: Enterprise buyer, agency, or budget holder named by evidence.

DemandEvent.description: Job posting, procurement, adoption, contract, or customer evidence.

RevenueEvent.description: ARR, contract, revenue, or growth evidence.

Outcome.description: Acquisition, IPO, shutdown, or other observable company outcome.

MetricSnapshot.description: Versioned computed metric with formula, inputs, window, and calculation timestamp.

SecFiling.description: Structured SEC EDGAR filing identified by CIK and accession number.

OntologyConcept.description: Controlled technology, dependency, application, buyer, or pain concept connected with explicit provenance.
